title.suggested: The Coming Fight Between Allen and Goss

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Arthur Chambers and Billy Edwards expected Tom Allen to beat Joe Goss, recalling their draw nine years before, but doubted Goss would fight for at least four months.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Dispatch, Wednesday Evening, May 10, 1876'. Before 1878-12, so not the Post-Dispatch.

facts.fact: Allen and Joe Goss had fought a draw about nine years earlier, when Allen was comparatively young

notes: Title suggestion only fixes capitalization. Draw year is computed from 'nine years ago'.
